Bahrain school holidays 2026–2027

Shows the days and hours until the next break, the school days left, and every holiday this year with return dates.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

How many days to the holiday?

Bahrain school calendar 2026–2027

Semester 1Thu, 3 Sept 2026 – Thu, 14 Jan 2027——

Students returned to classrooms on 3 September 2026 after about seven months of remote learning, so emergency decisions can override any calendar. The countdown also adds the expected official holidays such as National Day and Eid al-Adha.

Frequently asked questions

When is the 2027 mid-year break in Bahrain?

From Sunday 17 January to Thursday 28 January 2027 (12 days), back on Sunday 31 January, as Akhbar Al Khaleej reported from the ministry.
